title: Multimedia Midterm Visuals
lede: All five sample midterms, every question: 10 multiple-choice and 8 written questions each. Each question has the answer, the picture that makes it click, and the line to remember for the exam. Numbers come from the lecture slides and were checked in Python.
foot: Sources: the course slides (L = lecture, p = slide) and the study notes in Midterms/MultimediaComputing/notes.
